current_collection: Separate locked current-public source build for catalog validation; analytical notebook uses only published native release.
comparison: The interfaces have identical 8 logical names and signatures. Current source changes the transcode implementation for UTF-16LE/BE output and rejects replacement encoding; those paths are outside the three selected export codecs. A real SQL probe returns 68C3A9 for transcode(hé,UTF-16LE) on release and 6800E900 on current source. Metadata/examples and tests also changed; other demonstrated decoding, detection, repair and legacy/UTF-8 export logic is unchanged. Interface coverage does not claim implementation equivalence or exhaustive codec tests.
data_isolation: Both catalog probes and notebook connections use an empty temporary secret_directory and allow_persistent_secrets=False. Pure in-memory byte transformations; no authentication/write surfaces.
